name: MC-6 rect: only record 0 counts (shore ignored)
old: for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) if (table[bytes[row + x]]) return true;
new: for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) if (bytes[row + x] === 0) return true;

name: MC-6 rect: every byte counts (dirt says water)
old: for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) if (table[bytes[row + x]]) return true;
new: for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) if (table[bytes[row + x]] !== undefined) return true;

name: MC-6 rect: never says water
old: for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) if (table[bytes[row + x]]) return true;
new: for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) if (false && table[bytes[row + x]]) return true;

name: MC-6 rect: w clamps to 15
old: const w = Math.min(width, dim), h = Math.min(height, dim);
new: const w = Math.min(width, dim) - 1, h = Math.min(height, dim);

name: MC-6 rect: stride uses width not dim
